How can I create a 3x3 product campaign grid from one reference photo? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
Creating a 3x3 product campaign grid from a single reference photo can be approached in two entirely different ways depending on your creative goal. You can either split one wide/large image into a giant nine-tile social media puzzle, or you can use generative AI to turn one product photo into nine distinct, cohesive advertising concepts.
Method 1: The AI Generation Approach (9 Distinct Ads)
If you want to take a single product reference photo and generate nine different commercial scenes (e.g., macro detail, liquid interaction, minimalist staging) while keeping the product completely consistent, you can use advanced AI image diffusion workflows.
ComfyUI Workflow: You can build or download a specialized ComfyUI workflow that uses an image generator to produce a 3x3 layout in a single generation. This method maps the reference image for core product consistency but allows you to prompt each of the nine grid cells with different environments, backgrounds, and lighting. Once generated, you can isolate and upscale your favorite panels.
Structured AI Prompting: Platforms like Midjourney allow you to upload your product photo as an image weight reference. You can then use a targeted commercial marketing prompt to enforce a 3x3 layout.
Sample Execution: Upload your product image and use a prompt structurally mapped out like: "Create a 3x3 grid in a 3:4 aspect ratio for a high-end commercial marketing campaign using the uploaded product as the central subject. Each frame must present a distinct visual concept while maintaining perfect product consistency..." followed by specific grid concepts for each cell (e.g., cell 1: iconic hero still life; cell 2: extreme macro detail; cell 3: liquid interaction). Append parameters like --ar 3:4 --iw 2 to lock in the layout and closely anchor to the reference photo.
Method 2: The Grid Splitting Approach (1 Large Image into 9 Tiles)
If you already have a stunning, high-resolution campaign image that you want to slice into an Instagram feed reveal or grid layout, you can use specialized, browser-based splitter tools.
Dedicated Grid Splitters: Browser-based processing tools like 9grid or PixGrid allow you to upload your single reference photo, select a 3x3 layout, adjust your crop boundaries, and export nine perfectly split tiles locally without losing original image resolution.
Canvas Layout Specifications: To make sure your campaign grid looks crisp and seamless when published, match your graphic composition to standardized digital dimensions:
Classic Square Grid: Build your whole reference image at 3240 x 3240 pixels to export nine individual 1080 x 1080 pixel tiles.
Modern Portrait Grid (3:4): Build at 3240 x 4320 pixels to yield nine 1080 x 1440 pixel tiles.
Social Portrait Grid (4:5): Build at 3240 x 4050 pixels to yield nine 1080 x 1350 pixel tiles.
The Publishing Rule: Whether using Split an Image or a similar script, always check that vital text, logos, or faces do not fall awkwardly on the grid split lines before exporting. When posting to social platforms, upload the sliced files in reverse order (from tile 9/last down to tile 1/first) so they piece together correctly on your profile feed.
To give you the most relevant instructions, let me know:
Are you trying to slice up one big image to fit a 9-tile layout, or do you want AI to generate 9 completely different scenes starring your product?
What specific social platform or marketing medium is this campaign grid for?
